content: You will be given an argumentation and asked about to find the relation from relation types: sup (support), exa (support by example), add (additional source), reb (rebutting attack), und (undercutting attack), joint (joining relation) between two selected argument components from it.

Today I will delete my Facebook account. Not only because I'm constantly astonished about who wants to be my friend. I'm also tired of my data boosting the market value of that corporation. Facebook warns me emphatically that I may lose contact with my friends. And yet now I'll actually have all the more time for them.
What is the relation between "And yet now I'll actually have all the more time for them." and "Facebook warns me emphatically that I may lose contact with my friends." from the above essay? Choose from following options  1. reb
2. und
3. joint
4. exa
5. sup
6. no relation
